name: WhatsApp
refreshNote: No official debugger or cache-refresh tool. Previews are generated when the sender types/pastes the link and cached; change the URL (e.g. add a query string) to force a new preview.
notes: Official (WhatsApp Business Platform 'Link Previews' doc): requires og:title, og:description, og:url, og:image; the <head> must appear within the first 300KB of the HTML; image should be under 600KB, at least 300px wide, aspect ratio (w/h) of 4:1 or less.
maxBytes 614400 = 600KB per the official doc. Several secondary sources report that images above ~300KB are dropped in practice - keep og:image well under 300KB to be safe (uncertain).

Large vs small (secondary sources): images >= 300px wide show as a full-width image above title/description; ~100-300px wide show as a small thumbnail beside the text; < 100px are dropped. Crop ratio of the large image not documented (null).
Fallbacks to <title>/meta description are estimates; the doc only names the og: tags. Formats: JPEG/PNG documented widely; webp is a secondary-source claim; SVG not supported (estimate).
Title/description truncation is line-based (about 2 lines each) and not documented; null.

Verification method: official doc pages were located via web search (search-engine extracts of the official URLs listed in source); direct page fetches of the official domain were blocked from the research environment, so wording could not be re-read in full.
